mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the front fin completed the visible whale shape, bringing the panels, tail and fins together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Turning back to the front was clear but less engaging as a separate text command.

surprise.text: Flipping changed the displayed object name from Whale carrier to Whale, then fittings changed it back.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the flips exposed the sides needed for their fittings.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the completed whale is used, though the repetitive text commands make that a tentative choice.
